subject: Your audio is about to get smarter
preview_text: A big update is landing in Loud EQ next week. Here's what you need to know first.
body_paragraphs: You know that feeling when you're on a crowded train, phone volume maxed, and still straining to catch every word of your podcast? That's about to become a memory. Loud EQ's next update is rolling out—and you're hearing about it here first.

We've been quietly working on something that learns your listening habits. It's a new mode called Sound DNA that builds a custom profile based on the audio you actually play. Music, podcasts, calls—it adapts in real time so you never have to tweak a slider again.

This isn't a gimmick. It's the same tech that's been making our hearing-safe streak one of the most used features. Thousands of users have already tested it in beta and their feedback is clear: it's like the app finally gets you. No more generic boosts. Just clear, loud audio that matches your ears and your environment.

When the update drops, open the app and tap Optimize with your favorite headphones plugged in. That's it. The rest happens automatically. P.S. Premium users will get early access to Sound DNA before anyone else. If you're on the free version, now's the time to see what you're missing.
